Made for the actual work

The hours matter.
So do the details.

01

Your timecard, imported

Import a CSV or paste your timecard. The timecard is the source of truth: Clockin reconciles matching days instead of counting the same work twice.

02

Rates that change over time

Give each rate a start date. Past work keeps the rate that applied then. See your earnings in your currency, with a Turkish lira equivalent.

03

Goals that know your pace

Set daily and monthly hours and how many days a week you work. Progress shows what is left and the time you will reach today’s goal.

04

Focus chime and radio

A gentle chime on the interval you pick, eight sounds to choose from, and internet radio while you work.

Your work is personal.

Pay, earnings and notes stay on your devices and in your own iCloud when sync is enabled. The Live Activity relay gets only a temporary push address—not your work data.
